source.commit_body:
Replaces the prior binary ±1-day null in volume_amplifier with a smooth
pre-earnings log-gradient blend toward NEUTRAL. Mirrors v28's earnings-boost
proximity formula log(W+1-d)/log(W+1) so the two stages compose on the
same curve.

Mechanism:
    nearest_d = (nearest forward earnings) - today, calendar days
    if 0 <= nearest_d <= W:
        strength = M * log(W+1-nearest_d) / log(W+1)
        result   = blend(amplifier_output, NEUTRAL, strength)
    where W=2, M=1.0.

Pre-only direction (no suppression for nearest_d < 0). V7 (post-only)
sweep confirmed post-earnings price action carries genuine directional
signal — even mild post-fade collapses 95+ WR by 11pp.

Per-trade evidence (5y diff-assess vs v28 production, full universe):
- 95+:  N 38 -> 46 (+21%), WR15 92.1% -> 93.5% (+1.4pp)
- 90+:  N 150 -> 170 (+13%), WR15 80.7% -> 81.8% (+1.1pp)
- 85+:  N 478 -> 523 (+9%), WR15 80.0% -> 80.6% (+0.6pp)
- 70+:  WR15 71.3% -> 71.4% (≈)
- <25:  WR15 75.3% -> 75.0% (≈, put side indifferent)
- <5:   WR15 80.5% -> 80.2% (≈)

The pattern is N expansion AT HIGHER WR — opposite of the V1/V4/V5
dilution failure mode. The smooth ramp recovers genuinely informative
signals that the binary D-1 null was hard-filtering at the boundary.

Note on v24 reversion (2026-04-25): the prior fix attempt removed D-1
suppression entirely (binary OFF→ON at boundary), losing −40% to −59%
on canonical MC. V6 keeps D-1 partially suppressed (s=0.631) so the
anticipation-noise filter is preserved as a smooth ramp, not eliminated.

Validation gate (canonical 3-mode MC vs v28 baseline) runs after
recalculate. If the gate fails, revert via `trader revert v28`.

Patch sites:
- volume_amplifier.py: removed binary suppression in _analyze and
  _analyze_from_cache; added _earnings_supp_strength, _apply_earn_supp,
  _query_earn_nearest_d_db, _earn_nearest_d_from_set helpers; outer
  wrappers (get_volume_multiplier, get_volume_multiplier_from_cache)
  apply the gradient at end-of-pipeline.
- experiments/v28_optimization/phase_evs_per_trade.py — 8-variant
  per-trade A/B harness (V0/V1/V2..V7) + 2y output.
- experiments/v28_optimization/phase_evs_per_trade_v6_focus.py —
  focused 5y run on V6 + neighbors (W=3, M=0.85, hybrid V8) + output.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.7 <noreply@anthropic.com>
